I don't see any remotes configured in this repo yet. To write an SSH config entry, I need to know:

1. **The hostname/domain** of your internal remote (e.g., `git.internal.company.com`, `gitea.local`, etc.)
2. **The repository path** (if needed)

Once you provide the internal remote URL, I can create an SSH config entry. For example, if your internal remote is `git@internal.company.com:myrepo.git`, I'd add something like:

```
Host internal.company.com
    HostName internal.company.com
    User git
    IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
```

What's the hostname/URL of your internal remote?
